fact: On 18 March 2025 Libya Post was installing postal address plaques in Hay Al-Andalus municipality, targeting 24,000 buildings in the first phase of a programme extending postal addressing across the country's municipalities.
title: شركة بريد ليبيا تطلق مشروع العنونة البريدية في نطاق بلدية حي الاندلس
